description: Exact-copy DUT-independent proofs over the shared FIRRTL semantics; external libraries are required. No CoreSocModel or ComparisonNodes dependency.

declarations.name: restore_preserves_agreement
declarations.declaration:
Lemma restore_preserves_agreement (old_map current : VM.t hvalue) id name value :
 VM.find id current = VM.find id old_map ->
 VM.find name old_map = Some value ->
 VM.find id (VM.add name value current) = VM.find id old_map.

declarations.name: finish_false_preserves_agreement
declarations.declaration:
Lemma finish_false_preserves_agreement : forall (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq)
 (eval : HiF.hfexpr -> option hvalue) old_map current result id,
 VM.find id current = VM.find id old_map ->
 finish_registers eval old_map false current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find id result = VM.find id old_map.

declarations.name: has_register
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint has_register (id : VarOrder.T) (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq) : bool :=
 match stmts with
 | Qnil => false
 | Qcons st tl =>
   (match st with
    | Sreg name _ => id == name
    | Swhen _ yes no => has_register id yes || has_register id no
    | _ => false end) || has_register id tl
 end.

declarations.name: finish_false_holds_registers
declarations.declaration:
Lemma finish_false_holds_registers : forall (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq)
 (eval : HiF.hfexpr -> option hvalue) old_map current result id,
 has_register id stmts = true ->
 finish_registers eval old_map false current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find id result = VM.find id old_map.

declarations.name: normalized_bit
declarations.declaration:
Inductive normalized_bit : hvalue -> Prop :=
 | normalized_known b : normalized_bit (Gval (Fuint 1) [::b])
 | normalized_pending : normalized_bit (Needtobedefined (Gtyp (Fuint 1)))
 | normalized_uninitialized : normalized_bit (Uninitialized (Gtyp (Fuint 1)))
 | normalized_invalid : normalized_bit (Undefinedonpurpose (Gtyp (Fuint 1))).

declarations.name: adapted_bit_normalized
declarations.declaration:
Lemma adapted_bit_normalized input result :
 adapt_hvalue_as_type input (Gtyp (Fuint 1)) = Some result -> normalized_bit result.

declarations.name: bit_or_known
declarations.declaration:
Definition bit_or_known value bit :=
 match eval_binop Bor value (Gval (Fuint 1) [::bit]) with
 | Some result => result | None => Needtobedefined (Gtyp (Fuint 1)) end.

declarations.name: bit_eq_false
declarations.declaration:
Definition bit_eq_false value :=
 match eval_binop (Bcomp Beq) value (Gval (Fuint 1) [::false]) with
 | Some result => result | None => Needtobedefined (Gtyp (Fuint 1)) end.

declarations.name: bit_or_known_eval
declarations.declaration:
Lemma bit_or_known_eval value bit : normalized_bit value ->
 eval_binop Bor value (Gval (Fuint 1) [::bit]) = Some (bit_or_known value bit).

declarations.name: bit_or_known_normal
declarations.declaration: Lemma bit_or_known_normal value bit : normalized_bit value -> normalized_bit (bit_or_known value bit).

declarations.name: bit_eq_false_eval
declarations.declaration:
Lemma bit_eq_false_eval value : normalized_bit value ->
 eval_binop (Bcomp Beq) value (Gval (Fuint 1) [::false]) = Some (bit_eq_false value).

declarations.name: bit_eq_false_normal
declarations.declaration: Lemma bit_eq_false_normal value : normalized_bit value -> normalized_bit (bit_eq_false value).

declarations.name: normalized_bit_type
declarations.declaration: Lemma normalized_bit_type value : normalized_bit value -> type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint 1).

declarations.name: normalized_bit_adapt
declarations.declaration:
Lemma normalized_bit_adapt value : normalized_bit value ->
 adapt_hvalue_as_type value (Gtyp (Fuint 1)) = Some value.

declarations.name: checker_valid_symbolic
declarations.declaration: Definition checker_valid_symbolic bubble stall reset := bit_eq_false (bit_or_known (bit_or_known bubble stall) reset).

declarations.name: checker_valid_symbolic_normal
declarations.declaration:
Lemma checker_valid_symbolic_normal bubble stall reset : normalized_bit bubble ->
 normalized_bit (checker_valid_symbolic bubble stall reset).

declarations.name: checker_valid_symbolic_true
declarations.declaration:
Lemma checker_valid_symbolic_true bubble stall reset : normalized_bit bubble ->
 checker_valid_symbolic bubble stall reset = Gval (Fuint 1) [::true] ->
 bubble = Gval (Fuint 1) [::false] /\ stall = false /\ reset = false.

declarations.name: concrete_uint_mux_const_ref

   value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid [::] 0 mm old set_regs current stmts = Some proposed /\

declarations.declaration:
Lemma nonmemory_invalidation_preserves_other mm set_regs node reference make_value old current result :
 node != HiF.base_ref reference ->
 (match reference with
  | Esubfield (Esubfield (Eid mem) port) field =>
      is_memory_data_port true mm mem port field = false
  | _ => True end) ->
 invalidate_ref_with_memory mm set_regs reference make_value old current = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = VM.find node current.

declarations.name: invalid_statement_node_projection
declarations.declaration:
Lemma invalid_statement_node_projection invalid scope position mm old set_regs
 current result tail node reference :
 node != HiF.base_ref reference ->
 (match reference with
  | Esubfield (Esubfield (Eid mem) port) field =>
      is_memory_data_port true mm mem port field = false
  | _ => True end) ->
 (forall next,
   VM.find node next = VM.find node current ->
   value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope (S position)
     mm old set_regs next tail = Some result ->
   VM.find node result = VM.find node next) ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position
   mm old set_regs current (Qcons (Sinvalid reference) tail) = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = VM.find node current.

declarations.name: node_statement_evaluation_projection
declarations.declaration:
Lemma node_statement_evaluation_projection invalid scope position mm old set_regs
 current result tail node expression :
 (forall value,
   eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old = Some value ->
   value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope (S position)
     mm old set_regs (VM.add node value current) tail = Some result ->
   VM.find node result = Some value) ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position
   mm old set_regs current (Qcons (Snode node expression) tail) = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old.

declarations.name: node_statement_preserved_evaluation
declarations.declaration:
Corollary node_statement_preserved_evaluation invalid scope position mm old set_regs
 current result tail node expression :
 (forall value,
   eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old = Some value ->
   value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope (S position)
     mm old set_regs (VM.add node value current) tail = Some result ->
   VM.find node result = VM.find node (VM.add node value current)) ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position
   mm old set_regs current (Qcons (Snode node expression) tail) = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old.

declarations.declaration:

declarations.name: connection_preserves_uint_source
declarations.declaration:
Definition connection_preserves_uint_source (node : VarOrder.T) (rhs : HiF.hfexpr) : Prop :=
 match rhs with
 | Eref reference => node != HiF.base_ref reference \/ reference = Eid node
 | _ => True
 end.

declarations.name: selected_connection_preserves_uint
declarations.declaration:
Lemma selected_connection_preserves_uint mm set_regs node lhs rhs width value old current result :
 type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint width) ->
 VM.find node current = Some value ->
 node != HiF.base_ref lhs ->
 is_memory_writer_ref mm lhs = false ->
 connection_preserves_uint_source node rhs ->
 (match rhs with
  | Eref reference =>
      if is_memory_writer_ref mm lhs then
        unidirectional_connect_with_memory mm set_regs lhs rhs old current
      else bidirectional_connect_with_memory mm lhs reference old current
  | _ => unidirectional_connect_with_memory mm set_regs lhs rhs old current
  end) = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = Some value.

declarations.name: scalar_suffix_safe
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint scalar_suffix_safe (mm : memory_map) (node : VarOrder.T)
 (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq) : Prop :=
 match stmts with
 | Qnil => True
 | Qcons st tail =>
   (match st with
    | Sskip | Sinst _ _ => True
    | Swire name _ | Sreg name _ | Smem name _ | Snode name _ => node != name
    | Sfcnct lhs rhs => node != HiF.base_ref lhs /\
        is_memory_writer_ref mm lhs = false /\ connection_preserves_uint_source node rhs
    | Sinvalid reference => node != HiF.base_ref reference /\
        is_memory_writer_ref mm reference = false
    | Swhen _ _ _ => False
    end) /\ scalar_suffix_safe mm node tail
 end.

declarations.name: scalar_suffix_preserves_uint
declarations.declaration:
Lemma scalar_suffix_preserves_uint : forall stmts mm node width value invalid scope position
 old set_regs current result,
 scalar_suffix_safe mm node stmts ->
 type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint width) ->
 VM.find node current = Some value ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position mm old set_regs current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = Some value.

declarations.name: safe_node_suffix_evaluation
declarations.declaration:
Theorem safe_node_suffix_evaluation invalid scope position mm old set_regs
 current result tail node expression width :
 scalar_suffix_safe mm node tail ->
 (forall value, eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old = Some value ->
   type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint width)) ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position mm old set_regs
   current (Qcons (Snode node expression) tail) = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old.

declarations.name: straight_drop
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint straight_drop (count : nat) (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq) : option HiF.hfstmt_seq :=
 match count, stmts with
 | O, _ => Some stmts
 | S rest, Qcons (Swhen _ _ _) _ => None
 | S rest, Qcons _ tail => straight_drop rest tail
 | _, _ => None
 end.

declarations.name: successful_straight_head
declarations.declaration:
Lemma successful_straight_head invalid scope position mm old set_regs current result st tail :
 (match st with Swhen _ _ _ => False | _ => True end) ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position mm old set_regs current (Qcons st tail) = Some result ->
 exists next, value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope (S position)
   mm old set_regs next tail = Some result.

declarations.name: successful_straight_prefix
declarations.declaration:
Theorem successful_straight_prefix : forall count stmts suffix invalid scope position mm old set_regs current result,
 straight_drop count stmts = Some suffix ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position mm old set_regs current stmts = Some result ->
 exists next, value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope (position + count)
   mm old set_regs next suffix = Some result.

declarations.name: full_iteration_node_equation
declarations.declaration:
Theorem full_iteration_node_equation count stmts tail node expression width
 invalid mm old set_regs current result :
 straight_drop count stmts = Some (Qcons (Snode node expression) tail) ->
 scalar_suffix_safe mm node tail ->
 has_register node stmts = false ->
 (forall value, eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old = Some value ->
   type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint width)) ->
 value_iter_with_memory_policy invalid mm old set_regs current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = eval_hfexpr_with_memory mm expression old old.

declarations.name: memory_storage_disjoint
declarations.declaration:
Definition memory_storage_disjoint mm node mem :=
 match VM.find mem mm with Some ml => node != ml_storage_id ml | None => true end.

declarations.name: write_memory_preserves_other
declarations.declaration:
Lemma write_memory_preserves_other mm mem port value phase old current result node :
 memory_storage_disjoint mm node mem ->
 write_memory_data mm mem port value phase old current = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = VM.find node current.

declarations.name: memory_connection_preserves_other
declarations.declaration:
Lemma memory_connection_preserves_other mm phase node lhs rhs old current result :
 node != HiF.base_ref lhs -> memory_storage_disjoint mm node (HiF.base_ref lhs) ->
 unidirectional_connect_with_memory mm phase lhs rhs old current = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = VM.find node current.

declarations.name: selected_memory_connection_preserves_other
declarations.declaration:
Lemma selected_memory_connection_preserves_other mm phase node lhs rhs value old current result :
 VM.find node current = Some value -> node != HiF.base_ref lhs ->
 memory_storage_disjoint mm node (HiF.base_ref lhs) ->
 (match rhs with Eref r => node != HiF.base_ref r | _ => True end) ->
 (match rhs with Eref r => if is_memory_writer_ref mm lhs then
   unidirectional_connect_with_memory mm phase lhs rhs old current
   else bidirectional_connect_with_memory mm lhs r old current
 | _ => unidirectional_connect_with_memory mm phase lhs rhs old current end) = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = Some value.

declarations.name: memory_suffix_safe
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint memory_suffix_safe (mm : memory_map) (node : VarOrder.T)
 (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq) : Prop :=
 match stmts with
 | Qnil => True
 | Qcons st tail =>
   (match st with
    | Sskip | Sinst _ _ => True
    | Swire name _ | Sreg name _ | Smem name _ | Snode name _ => node != name
    | Sfcnct lhs rhs => node != HiF.base_ref lhs /\
        memory_storage_disjoint mm node (HiF.base_ref lhs) /\ (match rhs with Eref reference => node != HiF.base_ref reference | _ => True end)
    | Sinvalid reference => node != HiF.base_ref reference /\ is_memory_writer_ref mm reference = false
    | Swhen _ _ _ => False
    end) /\ memory_suffix_safe mm node tail
 end.

declarations.name: memory_suffix_preserves_value
declarations.declaration:
Lemma memory_suffix_preserves_value : forall stmts mm node value invalid scope position
 old set_regs current result,
 memory_suffix_safe mm node stmts ->
 VM.find node current = Some value ->
 value_iter_statements_with_memory_policy invalid scope position mm old set_regs current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = Some value.

declarations.name: uint_source_safe_b
declarations.declaration:
Definition uint_source_safe_b node rhs :=
 match rhs with
 | Eref (Eid _) => true
 | Eref reference => node != HiF.base_ref reference
 | _ => true end.

declarations.name: uint_source_safe_b_sound
declarations.declaration:
Lemma uint_source_safe_b_sound node rhs :
 uint_source_safe_b node rhs -> connection_preserves_uint_source node rhs.

declarations.name: scalar_suffix_safe_b
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint scalar_suffix_safe_b mm node stmts : bool :=
 match stmts with
 | Qnil => true
 | Qcons st tail =>
 (match st with
 | Sskip | Sinst _ _ => true
 | Swire name _ | Sreg name _ | Smem name _ | Snode name _ => node != name
 | Sfcnct lhs rhs => (node != HiF.base_ref lhs) &&
   (is_memory_writer_ref mm lhs == false) && uint_source_safe_b node rhs
 | Sinvalid reference => (node != HiF.base_ref reference) && (is_memory_writer_ref mm reference == false)
 | Swhen _ _ _ => false end) && scalar_suffix_safe_b mm node tail
 end.

declarations.declaration:

declarations.name: scalar_expression_ready
declarations.declaration:
Inductive scalar_expression_ready (old : VM.t hvalue) : hfexpr VarOrder.T -> Prop :=
 | scalar_ready_const ground bits : scalar_expression_ready old (@Econst VarOrder.T ground bits)
 | scalar_ready_ref id ground bits : VM.find id old = Some (Gval ground bits) -> scalar_expression_ready old (Eref (Eid id))
 | scalar_ready_unary op arg : scalar_expression_ready old arg -> scalar_expression_ready old (Eprim_unop op arg)
 | scalar_ready_binary op left right : scalar_expression_ready old left -> scalar_expression_ready old right -> scalar_expression_ready old (Eprim_binop op left right)
 | scalar_ready_cast cast arg : scalar_expression_ready old arg -> scalar_expression_ready old (Ecast cast arg).

declarations.name: uint_scalar_ready
declarations.declaration:
Inductive uint_scalar_ready (old : VM.t hvalue) : hfexpr VarOrder.T -> Prop :=
| uint_ready_const width bits : uint_scalar_ready old (@Econst VarOrder.T (Fuint width) bits)
| uint_ready_ref id width bits : VM.find id old = Some (Gval (Fuint width) bits) -> uint_scalar_ready old (Eref (Eid id))
| uint_ready_unary op e : x0_uint_unary op -> uint_scalar_ready old e -> uint_scalar_ready old (Eprim_unop op e)
| uint_ready_binary op a b : uint_scalar_ready old a -> uint_scalar_ready old b -> uint_scalar_ready old (Eprim_binop op a b).

declarations.name: formal_typed_suffix_safe
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint formal_typed_suffix_safe (mm : memory_map) (node : VarOrder.T)
 (stmts : HiF.hfstmt_seq) : Prop :=
 match stmts with
 | Qnil => True
 | Qcons st tail =>
   (match st with
    | Sskip | Sinst _ _ => True
    | Swire name _ | Sreg name _ | Smem name _ | Snode name _ => node != name
    | Sfcnct lhs rhs => node != HiF.base_ref lhs /\
        memory_storage_disjoint mm node (HiF.base_ref lhs) /\ connection_preserves_uint_source node rhs
    | Sinvalid reference => node != HiF.base_ref reference /\ is_memory_writer_ref mm reference = false
    | Swhen _ _ _ => False
    end) /\ formal_typed_suffix_safe mm node tail
 end.

 type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint width) ->
 VM.find node current = Some value ->
 formal_statements invalid scope position mm old set_regs current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = Some value.

declarations.declaration:
Lemma formal_straight_head invalid scope position mm old set_regs current result st tail :
 (match st with Swhen _ _ _ => False | _ => True end) ->
 formal_statements invalid scope position mm old set_regs current (Qcons st tail) = Some result ->
 exists next, formal_statements invalid scope (S position)
   mm old set_regs next tail = Some result.

declarations.declaration:

   mm old set_regs next suffix = Some result.

declarations.name: formal_combinational_node_equation
declarations.declaration:
Theorem formal_combinational_node_equation count stmts tail node expression
 invalid mm old current result :
 straight_drop count stmts = Some (Qcons (Snode node expression) tail) ->
 memory_suffix_safe mm node tail -> has_register node stmts = false ->
 formal_value_iter invalid mm old false current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = eval_hfexpr_validif_policy (isolated_validif_policy invalid)
   (validif_raw_address [::] count 0 [::]) mm expression old old.

declarations.name: formal_typed_suffix_safe_b
declarations.declaration:
Fixpoint formal_typed_suffix_safe_b mm node stmts : bool :=
 match stmts with
 | Qnil => true
 | Qcons st tail =>
 (match st with
 | Sskip | Sinst _ _ => true
 | Swire name _ | Sreg name _ | Smem name _ | Snode name _ => node != name
 | Sfcnct lhs rhs => (node != HiF.base_ref lhs) &&
   memory_storage_disjoint mm node (HiF.base_ref lhs) && uint_source_safe_b node rhs
 | Sinvalid reference => (node != HiF.base_ref reference) && (is_memory_writer_ref mm reference == false)
 | Swhen _ _ _ => false end) && formal_typed_suffix_safe_b mm node tail
 end.

declarations.name: formal_typed_suffix_safe_b_sound
declarations.declaration:
Theorem formal_typed_suffix_safe_b_sound : forall mm node stmts,
 formal_typed_suffix_safe_b mm node stmts -> formal_typed_suffix_safe mm node stmts.

declarations.name: formal_combinational_known_node
declarations.declaration:
Theorem formal_combinational_known_node count stmts tail node expression width value
 invalid mm old current result :
 straight_drop count stmts = Some (Qcons (Snode node expression) tail) ->
 formal_typed_suffix_safe mm node tail -> has_register node stmts = false ->
 eval_hfexpr_validif_policy (isolated_validif_policy invalid)
   (validif_raw_address [::] count 0 [::]) mm expression old old = Some value ->
 type_of_val value = Gtyp (Fuint width) ->
 formal_value_iter invalid mm old false current stmts = Some result ->
 VM.find node result = Some value.

validation.scope: Asset sources recompiled unchanged against the recorded prebuilt external library artifacts; this does not rebuild or certify the external libraries.

schema_notes.modules: Exact-copy source inventory; asset is relative to this manifest directory. local_dependencies lists unqualified Require Import modules included here.
schema_notes.declarations: All top-level Lemma/Theorem/Corollary/Definition/Fixpoint/Inductive declarations. declaration is the source header before Proof for proven declarations; name and source line are available separately.
schema_notes.validation: Compile logs live only in build_directory under /tmp. commands compile the copied asset sources, using external libraries from the recorded snapshot; no external library rebuild or recursive kernel certificate is claimed.

portability_constraints: These are exact source copies over shared firrtl2coq semantics, MathComp, simplssrlib and nbits APIs, not standard-library-only templates.
No imported CoreSocModel, ComparisonNodes, FlatInstances, generated_modules or DUT signal IDs occur in this local closure.
ConcreteGround/UInt means a Gval constructor, not automatically well-formed bit length or supported width; retain width/size obligations.
uint_scalar_ready supports only its constructors and the x0_uint_unary operation whitelist (despite the historic x0 name), not all FIRRTL syntax.
NormalizedBit admits pending/uninitialized/invalid constructors as well as known one-bit Gval; normalized does not mean concrete.
Fixedpoint lemmas require an actual self-loop under the same input/policy/mode; finite budget is not convergence.
Frames require their declared suffix, source-disjointness, memory-alias, type and successful-execution premises.
